text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with 
Matikanefukukitaru—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! That is truly an omen of 
good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over to where Matikane Fukukitaru 
pointed, there was a claw machine filled 
with plushies designed after the 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My lucky item for today is a plushie!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so, being able to find this plushie 
must truly be the divine guidance of Lady 
Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If you win it for me, Trainer, since 
you're my lucky person, it'll bring 
super-duper mega great fortune!"
choice_data_list: Do you really want it that badly?
Do you really want it that badly?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I trust you to get plenty for 
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, Trainer, I'll welcome 
you by waving a big fisherman's flag~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
